title: Northgate+ Membership Addition in Northgate Card Credit Line Reviews
content:
When a requested credit line increase on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account is reviewed, the membership line addition follows the cardholder's Northgate membership in active status at the review, as the cardholder's **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** record shows it (the membership tier and its status):

- a Northgate+ Annual or Northgate+ Business membership adds 500 dollars;
- any other Northgate+ membership adds 250 dollars;
- no Northgate+ membership in active status adds nothing.

| Membership in active status at the review | Membership line addition |
|---|---|
| Northgate+ Annual | 500.00 |
| Northgate+ Business | 500.00 |
| Northgate+ Assist, Northgate+ Student or Northgate+ Monthly | 250.00 |
| the free Northgate Rewards tier only, or no membership in active status | nothing |

A membership that is not in active status at the review — for instance one that has lapsed or been cancelled — adds nothing.
